subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Should the narrowly scoped route-contract A/B experiment be scheduled now under the broader web-performance effort?
rationale: The source supports the investigation, but whether the measured potential warrants route-module churn is a scheduling and ownership choice that depends on real before/after bundle results.

options.title: Authorize the narrow experiment
options.body: Assign one loader/head extraction with explicit stop conditions and require manifest plus cold-navigation measurements before expanding it.

options.title: Defer under the umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open but postpone implementation until higher-priority work in https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2925 is complete.

recommendation.title: Authorize the narrow experiment
recommendation.body: Assign one loader/head extraction with explicit stop conditions and require manifest plus cold-navigation measurements before expanding it.

likelyOwner.reason: They assembled the baseline evidence and own the adjacent staged performance work, so they are best positioned to run or evaluate the A/B.
